pros: Whole course runs on roads closed to all vehicles inside the Batang industrial zone
Generous 210-minute half-marathon limit; every 2025 finisher came in under 3:27
Top-ten places within reach of good club runners
cons: Entry open to Indonesian citizens only
The 2025 route climbed before the finish and bunched up near the jetty (reversed for 2026)
Humid at dawn and about 30°C by 8.30am
Hotels in Batang were almost full on the 2025 race weekend
No route map or aid-station plan published
name: Industropolis Run 2026
short_description: Industropolis Run 2026 is on Sunday 6 December 2026 at the Batang integrated industrial estate in Central Java, over 5 km, 10 km and the half marathon.
ai_summary: Industropolis Run 2026 takes place on Sunday 6 December 2026 at Kawasan Industri Terpadu Batang, the integrated industrial estate in Gringsing, Batang regency, on Central Java's north coast. It offers 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon, with the official registration page giving start times of 5.00am WIB for the half, 5.30am for the 10 km and 5.45am for the 5 km, with published cut-offs of 90 minutes for the 5 km, 150 minutes for the 10 km and 210 minutes for the half.

faqs.question: When is Industropolis Run 2026?
faqs.answer: Sunday 6 December 2026, at the Batang integrated industrial estate in Gringsing, Central Java. The official registration page gives start times of 5.00am WIB for the half marathon, 5.30am for the 10 km and 5.45am for the 5 km. Race packs are collected at the estate on Friday 4 and Saturday 5 December.

faqs.question: What are the cut-off times at Industropolis Run 2026?
faqs.answer: The organisers publish cut-offs of 90 minutes for the 5 km, 150 minutes for the 10 km and 210 minutes for the half marathon. A 210-minute half is generous by regional standards, making it a reasonable first half marathon. Only half-marathon finishers receive a finisher jersey.
